VO_N1_: FailSafe six point zero point thirteen adds a simple path from your development Console to Statewright.
VO_N2_: Open FailSafe in VS Code, and launch the Console from the Command Palette.
VO_N3_: Select Integrations, then Catalog. Here you'll find Statewright A I, clearly labeled as a website handoff.
VO_N4_: Select Open Statewright Run History, and Statewright opens in your browser.
VO_N5_: Statewright shows its own Run History page. This account has no runs yet. They appear once a workflow is activated in a connected Statewright client. FailSafe does not import that history or enforce those workflows. This card is a link, not a connection.
VO_N6_: Open Statewright run history from FailSafe. Version six point zero point thirteen is available now.
